import hashlib
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

zip_path, outdir, ids = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3:]
z = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path)
for i in ids:
    data = z.read(f"{i}.json")
    (outdir / f"{i}.json").write_bytes(data)
    print(i, "|", hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
